item.title: Military leaders warn Hegseth against extending Iran war operations
item.description: A recent classified assessment advised that prolonged large-scale operations in the Middle East risk weakening U.S. capabilities elsewhere.

item.title: Russian strikes on food warehouses pose threat of shortages in Ukraine
item.description: Moscow has shifted to targeting shopping centers and food distribution sites, and markets in Kyiv and other cities are struggling to keep their shelves stocked.

item.title: Ka-nyet! Kanye West concerts canceled in Russia.
item.description: Two sold-out shows in St. Petersburg were scrapped, highlighting wartime ambivalence about Western culture and the rapper’s past antisemitic remarks.
